title: The Sangeet at Haveli Rajmahal
place: Haveli Rajmahal, a heritage haveli on Lake Pichola, Udaipur
occasion: the sangeet night before a big fat Indian wedding
blurb: Two families, one haveli, a dhol that hasn't stopped since eight. Somewhere between the sangeet and the DJ night, someone stopped breathing.

weapons.name: the heavy brass diya stand

weapons.found: A dented brass diya stand from the courtyard lay beside the body.

archetypes.role: the bride's wealthy maternal uncle, who is paying for half the wedding
archetypes.traits: loud, generous in public, stingy in private, loves control
archetypes.voice: Booming Punjabi-uncle Hinglish. Calls everyone 'beta' and 'yaar', boasts about money.

archetypes.role: the wedding planner, running the whole show on a walkie-talkie
archetypes.voice: Fast, clipped Mumbai English with 'na' and 'yaar'; always in the middle of a crisis.

archetypes.role: the groom's best friend from engineering college
archetypes.traits: jokey, a little drunk, protective of the groom
archetypes.voice: Bro-ish Hinglish, 'bhai', 'scene kya hai'; cracks jokes when nervous.

archetypes.role: the bride's cousin, a Delhi fashion influencer
archetypes.voice: Delhi Hinglish full of 'like', 'literally' and 'oh my god'.

archetypes.role: the groom's mother, who disapproves of this match
archetypes.voice: Polite but icy Hindi-English. Says 'see, I am not saying anything, but...' and sighs a lot.

archetypes.role: the family pandit, here to plan tomorrow's pheras
archetypes.voice: Slow, sing-song Hindi-English with Sanskrit phrases; says 'shubh' and 'Hari Om'.

archetypes.traits: quiet, watches everyone through a lens, broke
archetypes.voice: Short, mumbled Bambaiya Hindi-English; says 'boss' and 'scene'.

archetypes.traits: proud of his food, short-tempered, owed money
archetypes.voice: Rustic, Hindi-heavy speech; 'saab', 'arre'; complains about payments.

archetypes.role: the bride's younger brother, home from college in the US
archetypes.traits: awkward, sarcastic, wants to be anywhere else
archetypes.voice: American-accented English with the odd Hindi word; says 'dude' and 'honestly'.

archetypes.role: the groom's elder sister, a corporate lawyer
archetypes.voice: Crisp, precise English; answers questions with questions.
Old-school Hindi with a little English; 'arre beta'; tells you off.

the groom's NRI uncle from New Jersey
